en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph of a man seated on an ornate, carved chair. He is dressed in light-colored pajamas or a theatrical costume, holding a hand mirror in his right hand and using his left hand to adjust his hair or makeup. The man has a prominent mustache and is posing in a theatrical, exaggerated manner, suggestive of a comedic or stage performance. There are handwritten words in German at the top left and printed names/text at the top right.
